facts.value: Through ASU’s New Student Experience, accessed online in My ASU, you will prepare to take classes in the fall by completing essential next steps for enrollment.
Register and complete an Academic Orientation Session, where you’ll meet with your academic college and finalize your class schedule.
All students must complete the New Student Orientation Experience in order to enroll in classes.
Health insurance is mandatory for all registered international students and a condition of enrollment.
International students must have adequate medical and accident insurance coverage.
Mandatory student health insurance is automatically charged for all international students.
